grades.quote: enables `stimecmp` for S- mode when set to one
grades.reason: States the main gating condition. menvcfg.STCE=1 enables stimecmp for S-mode, and with STCE=0 any non-M-mode access raises an illegal-instruction exception. The henvcfg case applies only when V=1, which leaves the non-virtualized condition clear. The passage does not mention the mcounteren.TM condition.
Describes the machine-level mtime/mtimecmp memory-mapped registers. It says nothing about access to stimecmp from S-mode.
